```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r clear environment}
# clear environment for maximum reproducibility
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r load packages}
# load librarian (package for installing/loading packages)
if (!require("librarian")) install.packages("librarian")

# load requried packages
librarian::shelf(here, # relative file paths 
                 tidyverse, # data wrangling
                 BlakeRMills/MoMAColors, # color palette
                 piecewiseSEM, # structural equation modeling
                 lme4,
                 performance # check models
                 )
```

```{r explicitly assign functions if needed}
# make sure correct functions attached to the correct packages
summarize <- dplyr::summarize
group_by <- dplyr::group_by
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r set seed}
set.seed(0429)
```

# Set the color palette and graphics

```{r consistent color palette by treatment}
colorz <- moma.colors("Warhol", n=15, type="discrete")

b.color <- colorz[3]
control.color <- colorz[9]
crab.color <- colorz[1]
n.color <- colorz[6]
```

# Read in data

```{r}
physiology_1 <- read_csv(here("data", "physiology.csv"))
metadata <- read_csv(here("data", "metadata.csv"))
```

# Prepare data

Clean, join, and scale data

```{r}
metadata %>% 
  # join metadata and physiology data
  inner_join(physiology_1) %>% 
  # turn categories into indicators
  mutate(crab = case_when(
    crab == "Y" ~ 1,
    crab == "N" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ -9999
    )) %>% 
  mutate(nutrients = case_when( 
    nutrients == "Y" ~ 1,
    nutrients == "N" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ -9999
    )) %>% 
  mutate(interaction = nutrients*crab) %>% 
  # scale variables
  mutate(protein_change_scale = scale(protein_change)[,1],
         carb_change_scale = scale(carb_change)[,1],
         endosym_change_scale = scale(endosym_percent_change)[,1],
         dflav_density_scale = scale(dflav_density_per_1000cm3)[,1],
         gmono_density_scale = scale(gmono_density_per_1000cm3)[,1],
         sa_T1_scale = scale(sa_cm2_T1)[,1],
         sa_T3_scale = scale(sa_cm2_T3)[,1]
         ) -> scaled_data
```

# Make individual models

First we'll fit individual models. Most will be shared between protein and carb models

# Overall models

D. flavicaudus model

```{r D. flavicaudus model}
m.dflav <- lmer(dflav_density_scale ~ nutrients + (1|block),
                # REML = FALSE, # add if you want to calculate SEM chi-squared (but then won't work with summary())
                data = scaled_data) 
```

Note the `isSingular` message is because block is not improving the model/block effects are estimated near zero. We'll keep block anyway because of the design.

```{r check model}
check_model(m.dflav)
```

G. monodonta model

```{r G. monodonta model}
m.gmono <- lmer(gmono_density_scale ~ crab + (1|block),
                # REML = FALSE, # add if you want to calculate SEM chi-squared (but then won't work with summary())
                data = scaled_data)
```

Note the `isSingular` message is because block is not improving the model/block effects are estimated near zero. We'll keep block anyway because of the design.

```{r check model}
check_model(m.gmono)
  check_normality(simulate_residuals(m.gmono))
```

Endosymbiont density model

```{r endosymbiont model}
m.endo <- lmer(endosym_change_scale ~ nutrients + (1|block),
               # REML = FALSE, # add if you want to calculate SEM chi-squared (but then won't work with summary())
               data = scaled_data)
```

Note the `isSingular` message is because block is not improving the model/block effects are estimated near zero. We'll keep block anyway because of the design.

```{r check model}
check_model(m.endo)
```

# Protein model

```{r protein model}
m.prot.health <- lmer(protein_change_scale ~ nutrients + crab + interaction + 
                        endosym_change_scale + dflav_density_scale + gmono_density_scale + 
                        sa_T1_scale + sa_T3_scale + (1|block),
                      # REML = FALSE, # add if you want to calculate SEM chi-squared (but then won't work with summary())
                      data = scaled_data)
```

```{r check model}
check_model(m.prot.health)
```

Create pSEM

```{r pSEM}
sem.prot <- psem(
  m.dflav, 
  m.gmono, 
  m.endo, 
  m.prot.health,
  gmono_density_scale %~~% sa_T3_scale, # correlated error
  data = as.data.frame(scaled_data)
)
```

```{r summary}
summary(sem.prot, conserve = TRUE)

# for chi-squared (run on non-REML model):
# LLchisq(sem.prot) # same as without random effect
```

**Notes on the summary output:**
- For tests of directed separation, p-values > 0.05 means those paths are justified to exclude
- Fischer's C statistic > 0.05 provides support for the hypothesized model structure
- Do NOT report Chi-squared values for models fit with REML--if you want the chi-squared values (13.132 on 14 df with p = 0.516) re-run models with REML = FALSE and use `LLchisq(sem.prot)`

## Bootstrap direct and indirect effects 

To estimate effects, we'll simulate new data from the fitted model, but shuffle random effects and random residual noise, then refit the model to that dataset (n = 20,000 times)

```{r}
set.seed(0429)

boot.dflav <- bootMer(m.dflav, FUN = fixef, nsim = 20000, type = "parametric")
boot.gmono <- bootMer(m.gmono, FUN = fixef, nsim = 20000, type = "parametric")
boot.endo <- bootMer(m.endo, FUN = fixef, nsim = 20000, type = "parametric")
boot.prot <- bootMer(m.prot.health, FUN = fixef, nsim = 20000, type = "parametric")
```

Optional: save (or load)

```{r}
# saveRDS(boot.dflav, file = "boot_dflav.rds")
# saveRDS(boot.gmono, file = "boot_gmono.rds")
# saveRDS(boot.endo, file = "boot_endo.rds")
# saveRDS(boot.prot, file = "boot_protein.rds")

# if you've already saved and want to load:
# boot.dflav <- readRDS(here("boot_dflav.rds"))
# boot.gmono <- readRDS(here("boot_gmono.rds"))
# boot.endo <- readRDS(here("boot_endo.rds"))
# boot.prot <- readRDS(here("boot_prot.rds"))
```

Now stack the original coefficients (first row) on top of the bootstrapped ones (all other rows below the first)

```{r}
dflav_coefs <- rbind(boot.dflav$t0, boot.dflav$t)
gmono_coefs <- rbind(boot.gmono$t0, boot.gmono$t)
endo_coefs <- rbind(boot.endo$t0, boot.endo$t)
prot_coefs <- rbind(boot.prot$t0, boot.prot$t)
```

Now get these into a tibble with well labeled columns. Important notes:
1. Because of the standardization **all effects are in standard deviations of protein change per treatment**
2. Because interaction is its own 0/1 column the "nutrients" coefficient is the nutrient effect without crabs (when interaction = 0) and nutrients + interaction is the nutrient effect with crabs (and vice versa)
3. Indirect paths are the product of direct paths (e.g., `nutr_indirect_dflav`)

```{r}
tibble(
  # make a column that labels the first row as "estimate" (the original coefficients, which we made to be the first item using rbind() above), then the rest as "boostrap"
  type = c("estimate", rep("bootstrap", 20000)),
  # copy the direct effects of nutrients without crab from the protein model (first row is the estimate)
  nutr_direct_nocrab = prot_coefs[, "nutrients"],
  # copy the direct effects of nutrients with crab from the protein model
  nutr_direct_crab = prot_coefs[, "nutrients"] + prot_coefs[, "interaction"],
  # get the average effect of nutrients by multiplying interaction coefficient by 1/2
  nutr_direct_avg = prot_coefs[, "nutrients"] + 0.5*prot_coefs[, "interaction"], # averaged over crab treatments
  # indirect effects of nutrients via fish and endosymbionts; these don't depend on crabs
  nutr_indirect_dflav = dflav_coefs[, "nutrients"] * prot_coefs[, "dflav_density_scale"],
  nutr_indirect_endo = endo_coefs[, "nutrients"] * prot_coefs[, "endosym_change_scale"],
  # copy the direct effects of crab in ambient treatments from the protein model
  crab_direct_nonutr = prot_coefs[, "crab"],
  # get the direct effect of crab in enriched treatments
  crab_direct_nutr = prot_coefs[, "crab"] + prot_coefs[, "interaction"],
  # averaged over nutrient treatments
  crab_direct_avg = prot_coefs[, "crab"] + 0.5*prot_coefs[, "interaction"],
  # indirect effect of crab
  crab_indirect_gmono = gmono_coefs[, "crab"] * prot_coefs[, "gmono_density_scale"],
  # the interaction itself (difference in the nutrient effect with vs. without crabs)
  interaction = prot_coefs[, "interaction"]
  ) %>% 
  # now add the total effects of nutrients (direct + both indirect paths)
  mutate(nutr_total_nocrab = nutr_direct_nocrab + nutr_indirect_dflav + nutr_indirect_endo,
         nutr_total_crab = nutr_direct_crab + nutr_indirect_dflav + nutr_indirect_endo,
         nutr_total_avg = nutr_direct_avg + nutr_indirect_dflav + nutr_indirect_endo) %>% 
  # total effects of crab (direct + indirect path through G. monodonta)
  mutate(crab_total_nonutr = crab_direct_nonutr + crab_indirect_gmono,
         crab_total_nutr = crab_direct_nutr + crab_indirect_gmono,
         crab_total_avg = crab_direct_avg + crab_indirect_gmono) -> prot_effects
```

Now get: 
1. 95% confidence intervals for effects
2. Percentage point changes (by multiplying by one standard deviation to undo the standardization)
3. Relative magnitude of percentage point change relative to initial average protein (5.59% of holobiont AFDW)

```{r}
# initial protein content
init_prot <- 5.59

# calculate values
prot_effects %>% 
  # pivot and note that these units are in terms of 1 standard deviation
  pivot_longer(-type, names_to = "effect", values_to = "sd_units") %>% 
  # convert to percentage points (multiply by the SD used to scale protein_change)
  mutate(pp = sd_units * sd(scaled_data$protein_change)) %>% 
  mutate(effect = fct_inorder(effect)) %>% # keep effects in the order above
  group_by(effect) %>% 
  summarize(estimate_pp = pp[type == "estimate"], # get value for original estimate
            lower_CI = quantile(pp[type == "bootstrap"], 0.025), # get lower CI of bootstrap values
            upper_CI = quantile(pp[type == "bootstrap"], 0.975) # get upper CI of bootstrap values
            ) %>% 
  mutate(percent_of_initial = estimate_pp/init_prot*100)
```

# Carbohydrate model

```{r protein model}
m.carb.health <- lmer(carb_change_scale ~ nutrients + crab + interaction + 
                        endosym_change_scale + dflav_density_scale + gmono_density_scale + 
                        sa_T1_scale + sa_T3_scale + (1|block),
                      # REML = FALSE, # add if you want to calculate SEM chi-squared (but then won't work with summary())
                      data = scaled_data)
```

```{r check model}
check_model(m.carb.health)
```

Create pSEM

```{r pSEM}
sem.carb <- psem(
  m.dflav, 
  m.gmono, 
  m.endo, 
  m.carb.health,
  gmono_density_scale %~~% sa_T3_scale, # correlated error
  data = as.data.frame(scaled_data)
)
```

```{r summary}
summary(sem.carb, conserve = TRUE)

# for chi-squared (run on non-REML model):
# LLchisq(sem.carb) # same as without random effect
```

**Notes on the summary output:**
- For tests of directed separation, p-values > 0.05 means those paths are justified to exclude
- Fischer's C statistic > 0.05 provides support for the hypothesized model structure
- Do NOT report Chi-squared values for models fit with REML--if you want the chi-squared values (13.132 on 14 df with p = 0.516) re-run models with REML = FALSE and use `LLchisq(sem.prot)`

## Bootstrap direct and indirect effects 

To estimate effects, we'll simulate new data from the fitted model, but shuffle random effects and random residual noise, then refit the model to that dataset (n = 20,000 times)

```{r}
set.seed(0429)

boot.carb <- bootMer(m.carb.health, FUN = fixef, nsim = 20000, type = "parametric")
```

Optional: save (or load)

```{r}
# saveRDS(boot.carb, file = "boot_carb.rds")

# if you've already saved and want to load:
# boot.carb <- readRDS(here("boot_carb.rds"))
```

Now stack the original coefficients (first row) on top of the bootstrapped ones (all other rows below the first)

```{r}
carb_coefs <- rbind(boot.carb$t0, boot.carb$t)
```

Now get these into a tibble with well labeled columns. Important notes:
1. Because of the standardization **all effects are in standard deviations of carbohydrate change per treatment**
2. Because interaction is its own 0/1 column the "nutrients" coefficient is the nutrient effect without crabs (when interaction = 0) and nutrients + interaction is the nutrient effect with crabs (and vice versa)
3. Indirect paths are the product of direct paths (e.g., `nutr_indirect_dflav`)

```{r}
tibble(
  # make a column that labels the first row as "estimate" (the original coefficients, which we made to be the first item using rbind() above), then the rest as "boostrap"
  type = c("estimate", rep("bootstrap", 20000)),
  # copy the direct effects of nutrients without crab from the protein model (first row is the estimate)
  nutr_direct_nocrab = carb_coefs[, "nutrients"],
  # copy the direct effects of nutrients with crab from the protein model
  nutr_direct_crab = carb_coefs[, "nutrients"] + carb_coefs[, "interaction"],
  # get the average effect of nutrients by multiplying interaction coefficient by 1/2
  nutr_direct_avg = carb_coefs[, "nutrients"] + 0.5*carb_coefs[, "interaction"], # averaged over crab treatments
  # indirect effects of nutrients via fish and endosymbionts; these don't depend on crabs
  nutr_indirect_dflav = dflav_coefs[, "nutrients"] * carb_coefs[, "dflav_density_scale"],
  nutr_indirect_endo = endo_coefs[, "nutrients"] * carb_coefs[, "endosym_change_scale"],
  # copy the direct effects of crab in ambient treatments from the protein model
  crab_direct_nonutr = carb_coefs[, "crab"],
  # get the direct effect of crab in enriched treatments
  crab_direct_nutr = carb_coefs[, "crab"] + carb_coefs[, "interaction"],
  # averaged over nutrient treatments
  crab_direct_avg = carb_coefs[, "crab"] + 0.5*carb_coefs[, "interaction"],
  # indirect effect of crab
  crab_indirect_gmono = gmono_coefs[, "crab"] * carb_coefs[, "gmono_density_scale"],
  # the interaction itself (difference in the nutrient effect with vs. without crabs)
  interaction = carb_coefs[, "interaction"]
  ) %>% 
  # now add the total effects of nutrients (direct + both indirect paths)
  mutate(nutr_total_nocrab = nutr_direct_nocrab + nutr_indirect_dflav + nutr_indirect_endo,
         nutr_total_crab = nutr_direct_crab + nutr_indirect_dflav + nutr_indirect_endo,
         nutr_total_avg = nutr_direct_avg + nutr_indirect_dflav + nutr_indirect_endo) %>% 
  # total effects of crab (direct + indirect path through G. monodonta)
  mutate(crab_total_nonutr = crab_direct_nonutr + crab_indirect_gmono,
         crab_total_nutr = crab_direct_nutr + crab_indirect_gmono,
         crab_total_avg = crab_direct_avg + crab_indirect_gmono) -> carb_effects
```

Now get: 
1. 95% confidence intervals for effects
2. Percentage point changes (by multiplying by one standard deviation to undo the standardization)

```{r}
# calculate values
carb_effects %>% 
  # pivot and note that these units are in terms of 1 standard deviation
  pivot_longer(-type, names_to = "effect", values_to = "sd_units") %>% 
  # convert to percentage points (multiply by the SD used to scale protein_change)
  mutate(pp = sd_units * sd(scaled_data$carb_change)) %>% 
  mutate(effect = fct_inorder(effect)) %>% # keep effects in the order above
  group_by(effect) %>% 
  summarize(estimate_pp = pp[type == "estimate"], # get value for original estimate
            lower_CI = quantile(pp[type == "bootstrap"], 0.025), # get lower CI of bootstrap values
            upper_CI = quantile(pp[type == "bootstrap"], 0.975) # get upper CI of bootstrap values
            ) 
```
